text:
kai: Heads-up: Orion-lite v2 (int4) canary showing memory spikes and occasional OOMs when batch_size=10 and max_new_tokens=1024. Seen on west-eu1 nodes.
rachel: Any logs?
kai: Short excerpt: ```
[E] oom: alloc failed 1677721600
[warn] slab_frag: 0.39
[info] kv_slots_total=4096 kv_slots_free=28
[info] gpu_mem_peak=31.8GB total=32GB
```
pet er: peter: that free_slots count is tiny. Seems fragmentation + long-gen combos. Also noticed prefetch=true on this config.
rachel: Proposed quick mitigations for canary: batch_size=6, max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=false, enable lazy_kv_evict=true, kv_trim_threshold=0.18. Thoughts?
peter: +1. Also add request-time clamp: if prompt_len > 2000 -> max_new_tokens=256.
ops-bot: deploy requested by rachel to canary (pool=orion-lite-canary, commit=orion-lite-int4-v2).
kai: Applying changes now. Config used: ```
serving.runtime.batch_size: 6
serving.runtime.max_new_tokens: 512
serving.runtime.prefetch: false
serving.runtime.lazy_kv_evict: true
serving.runtime.kv_trim_threshold: 0.18
serving.runtime.request_clamps: - match: prompt_len >= 2000   set: max_new_tokens=256
```
ml-ci: scheduled eval job orion-lite-v2-int4-quality (suites: long-form-coherency, regen-diversity). ETA ~2h.
rachel: Quick perf check after change: mem_peak ~29.9GB, no OOMs for 30m, p99 latency +12% on heavy-gen requests.
kai: Note: early QA delta shows minor drop in n-gram overlap for ultra-long regens vs float32 baseline; need to check if it's quantization or the lower max_new.
peter: Plan: run 2 evals in parallel: (A) int4-v2 with max_new=512, (B) int4-v2 with max_new=1024 but batch_size=4 and aggressive kv_trim. Compare regen-coherence and token-level PPL.
rachel: If (A) matches quality +/- tolerance we keep new defaults. If not, try int8 build for canary to compare quality curve.
kai: I'll open a ticket TICKET-ML-4521 (Orion-lite int4 onboarding, frag/oom mitigation) and add runbook steps: rollback to int4-v1, emergency cap to max_new=128, and promotion checklist.
rachel: Agree. If canary stays clean for 6h we'll do staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with 24h monitors.
peter: Long-term: allocator compaction and smaller kv page sizes to reduce stickiness. Filed infra follow-up.
kai: Thanks team. Monitoring dashboards updated, will post results from ml-ci when ready. :thumbsup:
